The '''Brak sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] approximately twenty [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]] from the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] on [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]]. On the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] official reports it was listed as containing 67 inhabited [[Star system/Legends|systems]] and 355 uninhabited systems. The actual number of inhabited systems was around 90 counting the small, undocumented colonies and unofficial operations that existed in the sector.

The sector was home to only one native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Aramandi]]. They were a fairly isolationist group whose home [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] were located in the [[Aramand Cluster]].

==History==
[[File:Brak_Sector.png|thumb|left|250px|Detailed map of the Brak sector]]
During the rule of the Galactic Empire, the sector was governed by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lesan Ramier]]. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] only maintained a standard [[Brak Sector Fleet|Sector Group]] of 2,400 ships (including 30 Star Destroyers) in the sector since most of the sector was owned or dependent upon the [[Lant Mining Corporation]], a company loyal to the Empire. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garrik Trier]] was in command of the Navy's forces.

Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had begun building up a sizable presence in the Brak sector under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Trep Reskan]]. The Alliance maintained a number of small bases in uninhabited systems with their main operations point being [[Oracle Base]] in the [[Tel Minor system/Legends|Tel system]].

At the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] an independent [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]], [[Bacrana Shipyards]], operated in this sector yet remained free of the Empire.

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Brak sector was among the first sectors to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" />
